title: Tools for structural Bioinformatics
audience: MSc, PhD and research-level bioscience students

resources.name: PyMOL
resources.description: Official graphical molecular-visualisation software and downloads. Check institutional or commercial licence availability.

resources.name: Open-source PyMOL
resources.description: Source code and build information for the open-source edition; a separate option from the licensed bundles.

resources.name: PyMOL on conda-forge
resources.description: Community package route for installing open-source PyMOL in a dedicated environment.

resources.name: PyMOL command reference
resources.description: Selections, representations, alignment commands and scripting reference.

resources.name: UniProt
resources.description: Start with an accession, sequence and biological annotations; record the exact construct used.

resources.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
resources.description: Experimental structure entries, biological assemblies, ligands and primary citations.

resources.name: AlphaFold Database
resources.description: Retrieve existing predicted models and inspect their confidence and provenance.

resources.name: AlphaFold Server
resources.description: A hosted prediction interface. Check current access terms, accepted inputs and limits before using it.

resources.name: AlphaFold confidence guide
resources.description: Interpret pLDDT, PAE and interface-confidence estimates without equating them to experimental evidence.

resources.name: Foldseek Search Server
resources.description: Search structures against PDB100 and other collections. Redundancy reduction is not a guarantee of one returned hit per unique sequence.

resources.name: Foldseek documentation
resources.description: Local searches, alignment modes, output definitions and clustering documentation.

resources.name: Boltz
resources.description: Boltz-2 code and documentation for biomolecular predictions; inference requires suitable compute and setup.

resources.name: Boltz input guide
resources.description: Specify protein and ligand components and distinguish structural-confidence outputs from affinity predictions.

resources.name: EVcouplings
resources.description: Evolutionary sequence analysis and coupling-based structural hypotheses.

resources.name: ESM
resources.description: Protein language-model representations and structure-prediction documentation.

resources.name: BioEmu
resources.description: Approximate equilibrium conformational sampling. Samples are not time-ordered molecular-dynamics trajectories.

resources.name: RFdiffusion
resources.description: Classic constrained backbone and binder-design workflows; the lecture shows documented inputs, not a newly generated binder.

resources.name: RFdiffusion3 overview
resources.description: Atom-level chemical-interaction constraints in a newer design framework; do not assume classic scripts are interchangeable.
